entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Extract the netstandard facades for FX projects out of the SDK into an implicitly loaded NuGet package #51835
  • Concurrent Tool Installation can fail #51831
  • Audit usages of PreserveNewest/Always metadata to ensure support for IfDifferent #51829
  • Check dotnet sln list behavior for solution filters using both `\\` and `/` #51823
  • InvalidOperationException REBUILD fails due to "no file exists for the asset at either location" BUILD works #51822

Closed

Created

    Servicing-consider, Area-Watch, 10.0.1xx

  • Fix working directory of simple file-based apps #51828
    Area-run-file

    Area-AspNetCore
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'main' #51824

Merged

  • Reduce noise from CA1873 #51818
  • Merge main branch to release/dnup #51827
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #51812
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'main' #51814

Updated

  • Add --no-logo as a synonym for --nologo #50705
  • [dotnet-cli] prompt for target framework using `Spectre.Console` #51509
    Area-CLI, Area-Run
  • Add --self-contained and --no-self-contained options to dotnet test #51662

    Partner request, Document for new feature, Area-Run, 10.0.2xx

    Area-run-file
  • Suppress advertising manifest messages unless verbosity is diagnostic #51560
  • Update MicrosoftBuildMinimumVersion to 17.11.48 #51535
    Branch Lockdown

  • Rename dnup to dotnetup #51808
  • Fix CS2002 when EnableDefaultCompileItems=true in file-based apps #51790
    Area-run-file
